# freshdesk_ticket_field_section (Resource)

A dynamic section revealed when a ticket field takes particular values, letting a form show extra fields only when they are relevant.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) Name of the section.
- `ticket_field_id` (Number) ID of the dropdown field whose choices reveal the section. Changing it forces a new section.

### Optional

- `choice_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the parent field's choices that display the section.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the section.
- `ticket_field_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the fields shown inside the section.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import as <ticket_field_id>:<section_id>.
terraform import freshdesk_ticket_field_section.example 22:3
```
